inductions.IH_type: (∀ edge ∈ rest, edge ∈ storedEdges) → ∃ (fuel : Nat) (outcomes : List (Option (List (Option (Fragments.Fragment Symbol) × EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint) × EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint))), (∀ (extra : Nat), run heap (fuel + extra) scs rest before = outcomes) ∧ Language.All₂ (fun edge outcome => (SourcePruningEnumerationEdgeTraversal.prepare scs edge = none ↔ outcome = none) ∧ (∀ (action : EnumerateM Symbol Constraint (Option (Fragments.Fragment Symbol))), SourcePruningEnumerationEdgeTraversal.prepare scs edge = some action → ∃ (rows : List (Option (Fragments.Fragment Symbol) × EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint)) (after : EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint), outcome = some (rows, after) ∧ ExceptT.run (action before.core) = rows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core)) ∧ before.core.counter ≤ after.core.counter ∧ after.core.counter = after.core.values.length ∧ after.core.representatives = before.core.representatives ∧ Roots after.core.representatives roots ∧ StorageValid after.core ∧ PendingRealized heap after.core ∧ EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct roots after.core.values after.waiting ∧ (∀ (slot : Nat), SourcePruningEnumerationNativeIndex.candidate heap ((after.core.values[slot]?).getD .eliminated) = some (after.expandable slot)) ∧ (rows = [] ∨ ∃ result : Option (Fragments.Fragment Symbol), rows = [(result, after)] ∧ (∀ (fragment : Fragments.Fragment Symbol), result = some fragment → FragmentBound («Symbol» := Symbol) after.core.counter fragment)))) rest outcomes ∧ ExceptT.run (SourcePruningEnumerationOrdinaryBranches.run scs rest before.core) = (outcomes.map (fun outcome => match outcome with | none => [.ok (none, before.core)] | some (rows, _prefix) => rows.map (fun row => .ok (some row.1, row.2.core)))).flatten
